# YouR Star Inc.

> YouR Star Inc. (주식회사 유어스타) is an AI-native company based in Daejeon, Korea, founded in December 2024. It builds Lovely Tales, AI-powered personalized storybooks for children, and also provides software education and tech consulting.

## Key facts

- Legal name: YouR Star Inc. (주식회사 유어스타)
- Founded: December 2024
- Headquarters: 4th Floor J92, 566 Gyeryong-ro, Seo-gu, Daejeon, Republic of Korea
- Email: info@yourstar.space
- Products and services: Lovely Tales (AI-powered personalized storybooks for children), software education, tech consulting
- Trademark: LOVELY TALES, U.S. Trademark Application Serial No. 99476199 (USPTO), filed Nov 3, 2025, pending ([status](https://tsdr.uspto.gov/#caseNumber=99476199&caseType=SERIAL_NO&searchType=statusSearch))
